blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The father of the 16-year-old student involved in the deadly shooting at Banga National High School last month is facing criminal complaints after police found that his son had used a gun that was allegedly not properly secured at home. Maj. Robert D. Fores, officer-in-charge of the Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12) Public Information Office, confirmed Monday that the complaints were filed following the Sept. 18 shooting in Banga, South Cotabato, which left three students dead, including the shooter, and six others wounded.
